author: Patrick Cc:
description:
Modern SpongeBob Sucks. But most people don't know that the show was supposed to end 20 years ago after season 3. It's creator, Stephen Hillenburg, did not want the show to become a never-ending franchise. And after he died, Nickelodeon turned it into something completely unrecognizable.
